source_witness: User Library scan: אגרות קודש יח.pdf
volume_identity: Printed introduction identifies this as volume 18 and the letters as year 5719 (תשי״ט).
verification_method: INDEX-FIRST; actual scan images of the complete printed letter index on PDF pages 5-19 were inspected. Parsed text/OCR was used only as an extraction aid. Only monotonic, unambiguous extracted letter identities were accepted automatically; two opening identities whose initial ו was OCR-confused were visually confirmed. Ambiguous OCR rows were excluded rather than inferred.
verification_scope: published-edition bibliographic identity/volume/letter-number/index locator verified from inspected printed volume index; full wording not independently verified
exclusions: Does not verify full wording, manuscript, signature, incoming correspondence, substantive claims, or OCR completeness. Ambiguous index rows remain outside this batch for later exception review.
exceptions_note: Conservative partial index batch: ambiguous OCR rows were excluded. This batch is intentionally smaller than the full printed index and must not be treated as a publisher-stated total for the volume.
